name: full-bleed-band
title: Full-bleed band
description: A section background that runs edge to edge while its content stays on the page column, with no horizontal scrollbar.
docs: A FullBleedBand breaks out of its column to the full width of the nearest FullBleedBand.Root, which you put around the page once. The break-out is measured from that wrapper (a container query unit) and not from 100vw, so a classic vertical scrollbar never adds a stray horizontal one, and the wrapper clips what could overshoot. The band must sit in a column that is centred in the wrapper, such as a Container. tone is default, muted or inverted: an inverted band swaps the semantic tokens for its children (background, foreground, muted, border, primary and the rest), so text, borders and buttons stay readable in both themes. size is the vertical padding (none, sm, md, lg, xl), bordered draws a line along the top, the bottom or both, contentWidth takes the sizes of Container so the content lines up with the page, and as renders a section, aside, header, footer or nav.
